Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly stated that Ganga Bhavani was released in 2012, contradicting the WebSurfer’s results showing 1979/1978 (IMDb, Bharatpedia, AllMovie). They then fabricated/relied on placeholder sources (Amazon/YouTube) and concluded Ganga Bhavani was more recent than Occupation: Dreamland (2005). The correct comparison shows Occupation: Dreamland (2005) is more recent.
